heading: Brass And Mixed Metals ‘Top Interiors Trend’
bodyHtml:
If you’re getting ready to embark on a renovation project in 2020, it certainly pays to see what’s hot in the world of interior design. One trend that’s expected to be big in the coming year is brass, as well as mixing metals in interior design.

That’s according to Amy Kartheiser, an interior designer based in Chicago, who was one of a number of experts to recently share her trend predictions for our homes in 2020 with SFGate.

Speaking to the publication, she said that mixing brass with other metals is one of the best options if you want to incorporate this material into your home.

“Mixing metals is a great way to ensure brass doesn’t feel dated in a few years’ time,” she asserted. It’s also fine to combine brass and other warm-toned metals with the likes of chrome and silver, which are typically considered to be cooler in terms of colour.

To make sure you’re on trend with your brass, you also want it to have a more matte finish than you might be used to, the publication added.

Meanwhile, an article for The Zoe Report suggested that if you’re going to introduce dark colours into your home, you should think carefully about how you accessorise the space.

Offsetting dark shades with pale tones, particularly whites, is a good option, so consider these for soft furnishings like curtains. But you can also use metals, such as brass and chrome, to add some pop to walls painted in dark colours. Think the addition of picture frames or light fittings.
